knowledge_gaps: The gate is feasible, but its causal justification is unverified: sampled margins and simulator feedback do not demonstrate that stale interests cause ranking errors. Compare against simpler recent-history truncation and a fixed recent/full mixture before attributing gains to adaptive fusion.

The additional LayerNorm changes SASRec even when the recent contribution is zero, confounding the proposed isolation of context selection. Specify normalization, projection initialization, gate-weight initialization, optimizer settings, and exact window indexing. A gate bias alone does not guarantee an initial contribution near 0.1.

The evaluation plan lacks baseline HR@10, checkpoint-selection frequency, trial allocation, and a rule for selecting the four-model configuration. With only 200 validation users per category, repeated tuning can overfit validation. Diagnostics should also track gate distributions and sensitivity to recent versus older history.
Originality 3/10 is reasonable, but potential 7/10 remains speculative. Difficulty 3/10 describes the model change more accurately than the complete predictor, diagnostic, and evaluation integration.
